meta.note: Triggered by CREA's local card-detect script (which does the copy + verify — n8n NEVER touches the card). Receives the file manifest, splits it into shoots by capture-gap, then HUMAN GATE: owner replies to approve before anything is pushed to Higgsfield and the editor is notified. Nothing here formats or deletes.
meta.setup: Create Drive Folder is DISABLED by default (needs the CREA Google credential). Enable it and wire Split -> Create Drive Folder -> Record Shoots once Google is connected; then add driveFolderId to the Record Shoots + Higgsfield bodies. 'Push to Higgsfield' ships DISABLED — enable it and set CREA_HIGGSFIELD_URL once you have the Higgsfield API. The editor is still notified either way.
